description: Safety score 0-100 (higher = fewer incidents) and A-F grade for a point: incident density percentile against sampled occupied-area cells of the city (same radius) over its last 12 months. Not a prediction of personal risk; not comparable across cities. Outside covered cities it returns coverage "city_fallback": the city's FBI city-wide violent/property rates per 100k and national percentiles, no grade. May include a "tract" block: 2020 Census tract population and incidents per 1,000 estimated residents in the radius per year (tract residents only, so commercial and nightlife areas overstate risk).

address.description: US street address, used instead of lat and lon
